page.overview:
Who is Ramos?

Ramos is the Gym Leader at Coumarine City's Gym that appears in Pokémon X and Pokémon Y. He specializes in -type Pokémon. He gives the player character the Plant Badge after they defeat him.

Ramos is an old, lanky man with pale skin, a hunchback, and perpetually closed eyes. Fittingly for his advanced age, he is also bald and has very little hair on his head, save for his eyebrows and his spiky white beard. For clothing, Ramos wears a rolled-up long-sleeved green shirt with black buttons and brown suspenders, gray work pants with a brown belt and a holster, and green boots with brown soles. To complete his outfit, he also wears an orange scarf, a green cap, and thick green gardening gloves. Additionally, he is always seen with some gardening scissors, keeping them close by.

Despite his age, Ramos is active and likes to tease people (though he can be calm and soothing when it's needed). However, his advanced age gives him vast intelligence and experience, which he often uses to lecture people and give them advice. Additionally, he also speaks with a very thick accent, which is represented by his dialogue referring to people as "yeh" and "yer."

The name Ramos comes from ramus (Latin for "branch") and "moss".
